offering_description.value: Writes private passenger automobile insurance, plus homeowners, commercial auto, dwelling fire, umbrella and business owners coverage, mainly for Massachusetts residents. Sells through independent insurance agents and earns premiums plus investment income.

primary_products.value: private passenger auto insurance; homeowners insurance; commercial auto insurance; dwelling fire insurance; umbrella insurance

customer_segment.value: B2C: Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Maine drivers and homeowners; B2B: small businesses buying commercial auto and business owners coverage

end_markets.value: personal auto insurance; homeowners insurance; small commercial insurance

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums written and earned, plus investment income on the portfolio

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: underwrites and bears insurance risk, collecting premiums from policyholders and paying claims

geography_served.value: US regional: Massachusetts primarily, also New Hampshire, Maine, Connecticut and Rhode Island

specialization.value: related lines: personal auto, homeowners and commercial property and casualty lines

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent insurance agents across Massachusetts and nearby states

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurer subject to state insurance department regulation, notably the Massachusetts Division of Insurance and auto rate approvals
